title: Age-related macular degeneration predicted effector genes (Orozco et al., 2020)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Integration of eQTL and a Single-Cell Atlas in the Human Eye Identifies Causal Genes for Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
Orozco LD, et al.
Cell Rep. 2020 Jan 28;30(4):1246-1259.e6. doi: 10.1016/j.celrep.2019.12.082.
PMID: 31995762

In this study, SNPs in 35 loci genetically associated with age-related macular degeneration (AMD) in two GWAS (Fritsche et al. 2016, Persad et al. 2017) were examined for colocalization with eQTLs identified using expression levels from bulk RNA-seq analysis of human retinal pigment epithelium (RPE)/choroid and retina tissues of both macular and non-macular regions from 129 human donor eyes and genotyping of SNPs on 121 donor eyes.

The authors have created a searchable database for the eQTL results.

Click the Research Method tab for more details.
